# harborpilot_routing_plan (Resource)

A routing plan. Its routing logic lives in versions; see `harborpilot_routing_plan_version`.

Changes made outside Terraform are detected on refresh and shown as a diff of `spec`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_routing_plan" "default" {
  name = "default"
  spec = jsonencode({ display_name = "Default plan" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name (lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`).
- `spec` (String) The routing plan specification as JSON, usually written with `jsonencode({...})`. See the `PlanSpec` schema in the Harbor Pilot API reference. Properties you leave out take the server's default, usually their zero value (empty string, list or map, `0`, `false`), except `enabled`, which must be set.

### Read-Only

- `drift_state` (String) `drifted` when the object was changed outside Terraform since Terraform last wrote it.
- `id` (String) Stable object id.
- `managed_by` (String) Source of the last change (`terraform` after an apply).
- `revision` (Number) Server revision, used for optimistic concurrency.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id or by name.
terraform import harborpilot_routing_plan.example <id-or-name>
```
